semiconductor_relevance: High — Accuracy Assembly Automation Co., Ltd specializes in pick&place equipment and advanced packaging solutions for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Accuracy Assembly Automation Co., Ltd, based in Suzhou, China, is a prominent provider of pick&place equipment tailored for the semiconductor sector. With 16 years of expertise in micro-assembly, the company offers advanced die bonding solutions and technologies for various applications including IC packaging and sensors.
